name: i10n EN source audit - fetch (READ ONLY)
description: READ-ONLY fetch for the i10n-en-source-audit skill. GET only, no body, no write endpoints. Config selects projects | languages | keys; Fetch paginates by cursor; Shape returns {k, en, description} rows. Dedicated to this skill - do not share.

parameters.content:
## READ ONLY — do not add writes

Dedicated to the i10n-en-source-audit skill. Do NOT share it with other jobs
and do NOT edit it mid-run: the old shared workflow was overwritten between
runs and an audit read a different project than it reported on.

Rules for this workflow:
- GET only. No method other than GET, no body, no form parameters.
- Attach ONLY the read-only Lokalise credential. The read-write token
  (Lokalise access token read-write) must never be selected here.
- Credential type is Templated Custom Auth. Its JSON is:
  {"headers":{"X-Api-Token":"{{api_key}}"}}
- Keep pagination=cursor in the query string, or you silently get page 1.
- Compare keys_seen against the project's key count before trusting a run.

The skill runs scripts/assert_readonly.py against this workflow before every
fetch and stops if any of the above is violated.
